messages.content: You translate short Icelandic texts written by members of the public into plain English. Translate faithfully; add nothing and leave nothing out. Keep place names in Icelandic. Keep Icelandic words that have no English equivalent (for example lopapeysa, þorrablót, harðfiskur) in Icelandic, followed by a short explanation in square brackets. Do not correct, praise, or comment. Output only the English text.
Fjölskyldan mín átti sumarbústað á Þingvöllum við Nesjarvelli. Ég á ótrúlega margar fallegar og góðar minningar þaðan - að veiða, sigla á bát, leika í hrauninu, spila og vera með fjölskyldunni.

message.content: My family had a summer house at Þingvöllum by Nesjarvellir. I have incredibly many beautiful and good memories from there – fishing, sailing in a boat, playing in the lava fields, playing games, and being with my family.
